intendedAudience: Solution engineers using Microsoft Scout on macOS or Windows with authorized Microsoft 365 and Azure Pricing Calculator access.
does: Builds calculator-authoritative Azure estimates with separate environment estimates, one consolidated Excel BOQ, an unsent Outlook draft and an explicitly authorized Teams self-chat result.
expectedOutputs: Separate saved calculator estimates, verified share URLs and unchanged original exports per source/environment.
One consolidated Excel workbook with a formatted Summary and separate source/environment tabs, using native calculator totals.
Same-thread unsent Reply All draft for email sources; new unsent draft for ad hoc sources.
One authorized self-chat result with assumptions and links; quick questions use self-chat only.
toolsAndData: Microsoft Scout skills and local filesystem/shell capabilities.
M365 sign-in and profile; authorized Outlook email/attachment reads and private draft creation.
WorkIQ Ask for cloud Office documents; trusted installed executable discovered at onboarding.
Visible Playwright browser automation for Azure Pricing Calculator and supported Outlook/OneDrive/Teams operations.
Official Microsoft Learn documentation and public Azure Retail Prices API for evidence and spot checks.
Installed xlsx skill for export-preserving workbook consolidation.
Packaged tracker: macOS sh/sqlite3/shasum; Windows PowerShell 7 preferred, Windows PowerShell 5.1 fallback only when 7 is absent, native winsqlite3.
possibleActions: Create local private configuration, hash-only tracker state and permitted export artifacts.
Save calculator estimates and generate share URLs only after exact preview and confirmation.
Create or revise private unsent drafts without sending customer email.
Upload/share files or send Teams self-chat messages only after explicit confirmation of exact destination, recipients and content.
No purchases, deployments, CRM updates or automatic automation-setting changes.
approvedChanges: First-run configurable region and IANA timezone, with UAE North and Asia/Dubai as suggestions requiring confirmation.
Per-request AHB eligibility and licence coverage; otherwise licence-included pricing where applicable. Honor explicit licence-included requests.
Disclose applicable material Premium SSD v2 compatibility limitations.
GA default, explicit request-scoped preview opt-in with regional support, verified calculator pricing and deployment caveats.
Submitter name and team only; no email attribution.
additionalHardening: Removed author-specific executable path; discover installed tools rather than guessing home directories.
Aligned all output surfaces to one consolidated workbook and correct Reply All threading.
Defined Summary layout, sheet-name collisions, export fidelity and dependency-preserving consolidation requirements.
Removed companion shared-credit correction outputs that conflicted with native-total consolidation.
Added exact preview/confirmation gate for calculator saves/shares, cloud uploads and other outbound/shared writes.
Separated per-user configuration and runtime files from shareable static resources.
Preserved helper code, schema, payload hashes, existing tracker identities and reconciliation behavior.
